facts.fact: The Minister of Home Affairs replied in Parliament that the Department has developed the architectural foundations of a digital identity framework with enhanced biometric capabilities and is finalising long-term contracts with its biometric partners to build it.

The Minister of Home Affairs replied in Parliament that a redesigned, fully digitised National Population Register is being developed, with foundational development and contracts due to conclude by the end of the 2027/2028 financial year.
